page.layout: One title page. Centred: a large heading at the top, then smaller lines of title, a middle block of text, a woodcut device, and the imprint at the foot. No margins.
page.notes: Very faint scan. Much of the middle block is show-through from the reverse side (mirrored, upside-down text) and is not transcribed. The top line may read "LIBELLVM" with a small line above it; the lines marked [?] are uncertain. A woodcut device (an armorial or emblematic figure) sits between the middle block and the imprint. The line at the foot is a printed rule. Date and imprint readings are doubtful.
